1.Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court, is taken on record.
2.Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

3.This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire criminal proceedings of Complaint Case No. 7092 of 2021 (Chhaya Mishra Vs. Rahul Mishra and others), under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Aurai, District- Bhadohi,

sentences.text: 4.Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that opposite party No. 2 is the wife of applicant No. 1 and applicant Nos. 2 and 3 are the parents in-law of opposite party No. 2 and on account of matrimonial discord, the present criminal case has been instituted against the applicants, however with the intervention of the respected members of both the families and society, parties have amicably settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against each other.
A settlement-agreement dated 10.3.2023 has been drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexue No. 7 to this application.

5.Learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that applicant No. 1 has already paid a sum of Rs. 14,50,000/- to the opposite party No. 2 in lieu of all her claims and dues and now nothing remains to be paid.
6.This Court vide order dated 12.4.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the court below and to get the said compromise verified.

Pursuant to the said order, both the parties appeared before the court below on 2.5.2023 and in presence of both parties, the said compromise has been verified by the court below and a report dated 2.5.2023 has been forwarded to this Court, which has been annexed as Annexure- SA-1 to the supplementary affidavit.
7.Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that in view of the compromise made between the parties, the entire criminal proceedings against the applicants be quashed.

8.Learned AGA could not dispute the compromise made between the parties.
9.This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of :-
1. B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
2. Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation [2008) 9 SCC 677].
